commentary.bulkers: The Post Panamax "CMB Pauillac" 95/2012 Imabari, Japan (SS/DD 08/2022) was committed to undisclosed buyers for USD 25 mill. Remind you that a month ago, the two-years-older sister vessel "Double Fortune" 95/2010 Imabari, Japan (SS 09/2025, DD 08/2023, BWTS fitted) was sold at region USD 21 mill. Redwood Ocean Shipping have sold their Kamsarmax "Rosco Litchi" 82/2011 Tsuneishi Zhoushan, China (SS 01/2026, DD 01/2024, BWTS fitted) to Greek buyers for USD 25 mill. Note that the one-year-older sister vessel "MBA Liberty" 82/2010 Tsuneishi Zhoushan, China (SS 01/2025, DD 03/2023, BWTS fitted) was sold a month ago at USD 22 mill. Furthermore, Chinese owners sold their "Yangtze Xing Hua" 81/2012 Guangzhou, China (SS/DD 05/2022, BWTS fitted) for USD 22 mill, while the one-year-younger "Sea Neptune" 81/2013 Xiamen, China (SS/DD 03/2023) of Golden Ocean Group was sold to Turkish buyers at USD 23 mill. For comparison, the "Ocean Garlic" 82/2012 Dalian, China (SS/DD 06/2022) was sold a couple of weeks ago at mid USD 21 mill. Navios Maritime have committed their Supramax "Titan II" 57/2009 Stx, Korea (SS 09/2024, DD 08/2022, BWTS fitted) for USD 17,5 mill basis delivery August 2022, while the one-year-younger sister vessel "Karimu" 57/2010 Stx, Korea (SS 12/2025, DD 12/2023, BWTS fitted) was sold a month ago at USD 19 mill basis delivery April-July 2022. On the Handysize sector, MT Maritime Management sold their "Strategic Encounter" 33/2010 Zhejiang, China (SS 08/2025, DD 08/2023) to undisclosed buyers for low USD 14 mill. Remind you that back in February, the "Emil Selmer" 32/2010 Jiangsu, China (SS 12/2025, DD 02/2024, BWTS fitted) was sold at USD 14,5 mill.
commentary.tankers: Bergshan Shipping have committed their Aframax "Berica" 115/2008 Sasebo, Japan (SS/DD 10/2023, BWTS fitted) for region USD 23 mill. For reference, the one-year-older sister vessel "Taurus Sun" 115/2007 Sasebo, Japan (SS/DD 05/2022) was sold back in February at USD 17,3 mill. NYK Line have sold their MR2 "Challenge Pegasus" 47/2007 Stx, Korea (SS 08/2025, DD 09/2023, BWTS fitted) to Greek buyers R Shipping for USD 12,35 mill. Remind you that three weeks ago, the two-years-older "Super Emerald" 50/2005 Shina, Korea (SS 12/2025, DD 11/2024) was sold at USD 10 mill. In addition, the "Prime Express" 46/2010 Shin Kurushima, Japan (SS 11/2025, DD 11/2023, BWTS fitted) from Yamamaru Kisen was committed to Greek buyers for USD 15,5 mill. Note that the two-years-younger "Jupiter Express" 46/2012 Shin Kurushima, Japan (SS 04/2026, DD 05/2024, BWTS fitted) was sold back in February at USD 18,5 mill.
